line.a_ile_lat.text: Happy birthday, Hedgehog! How old are you?

line.a_swieczki.text: I'll bake you a raspberry cake! I already have the candles, I'll count them.

line.a_dwa_razy.text: Bear, you counted the middle one twice!

line.a_kazda_raz.text: When we count, we touch each thing only once. The last number tells how many there are.

line.a_ty_policz.text: Count my candles. Touch each one in turn.

line.a_trzy_swieczki.text: Three candles! As many as Hedgehog's years.

line.a_rozumiem.text: Each only once. Now I understand.

line.a_cyfry.text: Numbers can also be written with digits, look.

line.a_narysuj_trzy.text: Draw a three with your finger, starting at the green dot.

line.a_moja_trojka.text: My three! Because I'm three years old.

line.b_trzy.text: Three raspberries, just as many as in the recipe. Just right for the cake!

line.b_do_domu.text: We have the raspberries. Let's go home and bake the cake!

line.p_start.text: Let's practise counting to three! I have five games.

line.p_ile_jablek.text: Count the apples and point to the digit that says how many there are.

line.p_dwa.text: Give me two acorns. Drag them into my bowl one at a time.

line.p_dwa_juz.text: I already have two, that's enough!

line.p_rysuj.text: Draw a one and a two with your finger.

line.p_sluchaj.text: Listen to how many times the drum plays.

line.p_ile_bum.text: Point to the digit that says how many times the drum played.

line.p_trzy.text: Point to where there are three pears.

line.p_trzy_nie.text: Count the pears again. We're looking for three.

line.d_tort.text: The cake is ready! Does it have as many raspberries as Grandma's recipe? Count them.

line.d_trzy_lata.text: Three candles, because I'm three! Hooray!

line.d_rodzice.text: Count to three with your parents: three stairs, three apples, three jumps!

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for my birthday! Here is a sticker for your album, as a keepsake. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is Hedgehog's birthday cake with three candles. We got it when we learnt to count to three.

line.b_zagajnik.text: Look how lovely it is here! This is the raspberry thicket. The bushes are full of raspberries.

line.b_ile_malin.text: But how many raspberries go on the cake?

line.b_przepis.text: I have Grandma's recipe! The picture shows how many raspberries lie on the cake. Let's count them, then we'll know.

line.b_przepis_policz.text: Count the raspberries on the cake in the recipe. Touch each one in turn.

line.b_przepis_trzy.text: Three raspberries! The last number tells how many there are. We need three for the cake.

line.a_po_maliny.text: Now let's go to the thicket for raspberries. They're for the cake!

line.b_pod_liscmi.text: The sweetest raspberries hide under the leaves. Brush the leaves away with your finger!

line.b_policz_maliny.text: Count them, touch each one in turn. Are there as many as in the recipe?

line.b_niespodzianka.text: Hedgehog, I have a surprise present for you! Join the dots from the smallest one and you'll see what it is.

line.p_cyfry_ok.text: A one and a two, beautifully drawn!

line.p_bum2.text: Yes, the drum played two times!

line.p_bum3.text: Yes, the drum played three times!

line.p_gruszki_ok.text: Yes, here are three pears: one, two, three!

line.d_w_domu.text: We're home! The raspberry cake is baking. Let's lay the table for the party!

line.d_policze.text: I'll count how many plates we need!

line.d_kazdy_raz.text: We count each one only once. Let's check: everyone gets one plate.

line.d_rozdaj.text: Give each of us one plate.

line.d_zostal.text: One plate is left over! There are three of us, so three are enough.

line.d_na_stol.text: Put the three plates on the table, in the three places.

line.d_maliny_ok.text: Three raspberries, just like the recipe!

line.d_ile_swieczek.text: Now the candles. Point to the digit that says how old Hedgehog is.

line.d_ile_swieczek_nie.text: Hedgehog is three. We're looking for the three.

line.d_sto_lat.text: All three are out! Happy birthday, Hedgehog!

line.d_podskoki.text: And now three birthday jumps. Let's count together!

line.b_sa_maliny.text: There they are! They were hiding under the leaves!
